from.place: the derived direct-image composition proof uses the adjunction between derived pullback and derived direct image (Stacks Tag 079W)

title: Derived pullback is left adjoint to derived direct image
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] (more generally of ringed spaces). The derived pullback $Lf^*:D(\mathcal O_Y)\to D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-pullback] is left adjoint to the derived direct image $Rf_*:D(\mathcal O_X)\to D(\mathcal O_Y)$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image]: $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal O_X)}(Lf^*G,F)=\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal O_Y)}(G,Rf_*F)$ bifunctorially in $F\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ and $G\in D(\mathcal O_Y)$, with derived categories as in [def-pc-derived-category].
